lcc_original: 當那些日子，以及以後的日子，地上有巨人；神子【1】們進去找人類的女子們，生了兒子：那就是上古英武有名的人。
notes: LCC restructures the temporal clause: UNV splits into '那時候…後來…' (two separate time markers), while LCC merges both into one phrase '當那些日子，以及以後的日子'. WAH01992 (הָהֵם those) is placed on 那些, and WAH09002+WH03117 (בַּיָּמִים in-the-days) on 日子.
The second 日子 in '以後的日子' is LCC's own clarifying addition (no Hebrew lexeme); left unannotated.

{<WH03651>} (כֵן) and {<WH0834>} (אֲשֶׁר) remain implicit; placed at the close of the temporal clause before the semicolon, matching their function as connectors between the time-setting and the main clause.

LCC '找' (to seek/find) carries WAH0413 (ו+אֶל = 'and toward'): UNV uses the conjunction-preposition 和 for this tag, while LCC rephrases the directional sense as a verb of seeking. Tag is retained on 找 as the closest correspondent.
Chinese aspect particle 了 in '生了兒子' has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated per Rule 5.
